ops.body: - [loop] The editor that opens by itself after a capture (decision 0240) opens on Crop with the frame's handles live, so a thumb reaching for ✕ or Done while walking can graze a handle, which counts as an edit and makes ✕ ask "Discard these edits?" (opinion: the pictures cannot show a thumb). Open it with no tool chosen and Crop one tap away, or ignore a drag under a few points (fix edit-after-capture's review, ux U3, low).
